is-trossen_widowx_driver_crospi.description: To indicate that the tasks will be executed using the trossen_widowx_driver_crospi driver when running on the real robot.

robot_joints.description: Names of the joints that will be interfaced through this robot driver. These names need to be consistent with the ones declared in the URDF file of the robot and must exist also in the robot_joints declared in the default_robot_specification. The WidowX AI arm has 6 joints (the gripper is handled separately).

ip_address.description: IP address of the robot using Ipv4 format.

control_mode.description: Control mode for the robot arm.

periodicity.description: Periodicity in which the integration will be performed in seconds. 1/periodicity is the update frequency in Hz.
